claims.text: Luis Ramirez, a US casualty in Jordan, lost a leg on 9 September; Jordanian Ministry of Health said amputation 'successful'; prosthetic funded by a US veterans charity
claims.note: No report of any person of this name found. Air & Space Forces Magazine and Tribune India report US officials said no American personnel were killed in the 8 September attack on the Jordan base. Recurring invented character.

claims.text: Charity ledger shows a $12,000 grant; '24-year-old in a Jordanian ward'
claims.note: Invented detail attached to the invented casualty.

claims.text: Press TV: Iran ships 'defensive' missile kits to a Saudi-backed proxy in Yemen; kits financed by charity dollars
claims.note: No such Press TV report found; Iran is not reported arming Saudi-backed forces. Invented causal link.

claims.text: IRGC Navy forces 'seized' an unmanned US vessel in the Strait of Hormuz a day after Ramirez's story; Press TV described it as 'destroying a floating spy'
claims.note: IRGC said on 10-11 September it struck/destroyed a US Saildrone Explorer unmanned surface vessel (Tasnim, IANS via Siasat); the seizure claim (an unmanned underwater vehicle) was on 8 September (https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1788881711427-d8cb). No Press TV 'floating spy' quote found. US did not confirm.

claims.text: IRGC missile 'gouged a wall' at a US forward operating base outside Amman, damaging two warplanes
claims.note: The attack hit Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Azraq, not a base outside Amman. One A-10 had a severely damaged wing and about eight F-15Es were lightly damaged (Air & Space Forces Magazine); ABC News sources said nine warplanes. Not two.

claims.text: Iranian missiles damaged US warplanes at an air base in Jordan
claims.note: Attack on 8 September (ET), reported 9 September. Also https://abcnews.com/WNT/video/iranian-strikes-damaged-us-warplanes-jordan-sources-136352863

claims.text: Pentagon labelled the strike 'unprecedented'
claims.note: No Pentagon statement found; CENTCOM did not comment to Air & Space Forces Magazine and Trump denied damage.

claims.text: US response a 'half-hearted aerial patrol'; unnamed adviser called it 'warmongering accelerated power shift toward East'
claims.note: No source found.

claims.text: Yemen's (Houthi-led) armed forces took control of the Red Sea port of Mokha
claims.note: Tasnim, 10 September (page returned 503 on fetch; headline and summary via search). L'Orient-Le Jour headline 'Houthis seize Mokha city on Red Sea: Yemen military source' (https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1547108/houthis-seize-mokha-city-on-red-sea-yemen-military-source.html). Edition's date of 11 September is not supported: Tasnim reports 10 September.

claims.text: Press TV called the gains a 'strategic victory' after a week of 'rapid gains'
claims.note: No Press TV article found.

claims.text: Mokha mayor Aisha Al-Mansoor told Reuters 23 civilians were injured and three shops destroyed
claims.note: No such person or Reuters report found. Invented.

claims.text: UN condemned the weapons last month in a resolution that 'the IAEA's secretary' called 'illegal, political, and a product of US-Zionist pressure'
claims.note: No such resolution or quote found; the IAEA has a director general, not a secretary.

claims.text: YAF tightening grip on Bab al-Mandeb
claims.note: No source for 'YAF'; not checkable.

claims.text: Brent surged past $106 per barrel this morning
claims.note: No dated source for $106 on 11 September. A BingX AI summary put Brent at $107.63 on 10 September; psuconnect put it near $104 on 12 September. Treated as unsupported.

claims.text: 64% chance the Fed will hike again
claims.note: No source found; the September 2026 FOMC was discussed in terms of cuts, not hikes.

claims.note: Sent to OIRA on 25 August 2026 (https://theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-26-sec-sends-crypto-custody-rule-changes-to-white-house-for-review-412811).

claims.note: Internal sentiment scores; no public source.

claims.note: Bridge is issuer; selected customers in Denmark, Poland and Portugal from 26 August (https://theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-26-revolut-begins-phased-eurr-stablecoin-rollout-in-denmark-poland-and-portugal-412772).

claims.note: Bridgewater CEO AI job-displacement warning found only in late September 2026 (Bloomberg via secondary outlets), after this edition, and not with this phrase.

claims.note: Feed video titles; no CNN 'Havana pitch black' report from September 2026 found. Not used in rewrite.

claims.note: No source found.

claims.note: No source found.

claims.note: No source found. Bitrue preview (https://www.bitrue.com/blog/btc-price-prediction-september-2026) puts the FOMC decision on 16 September; the FOMC meeting was 15-16 September; minutes are published three weeks after a meeting, not the next day. 'Rate-hike trajectory' unsupported.

edits.headline: Iranian missile attack damages US warplanes at Jordan air base
edits.subheadline: One A-10 had a badly damaged wing and about eight F-15Es were lightly damaged, Air & Space Forces Magazine reported.
editorialBody: Iranian ballistic missiles damaged US aircraft at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan on 8 September, Air & Space Forces Magazine reported on 9 September.

One A-10 Thunderbolt II had a severely damaged wing and about eight F-15E Strike Eagles were lightly damaged, the magazine reported. US officials said no American personnel were killed. ABC News, citing sources, said nine US warplanes were damaged.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards said their navy struck a US Saildrone Explorer unmanned surface vessel at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, IANS reported on 11 September. The US did not confirm the claim.
Houthi-led forces took control of the Red Sea port city of Mokha, Iran's Tasnim news agency reported on 10 September.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian arrived in New Delhi on 11 September for the BRICS summit, Anadolu Agency reported. He was scheduled to meet Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi that evening.
The US Securities and Exchange Commission's rewrite of its crypto custody rules for investment advisers has entered White House review, The Defiant reported.
Revolut has begun rolling out EURR, a euro stablecoin issued by Bridge, to selected customers in three countries, The Defiant reported.
